'''May 2001 Findlay tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Findlay, Ohio on 12 May 2001. [[Brad Eier]] won it. It is known from Brad Eier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2285">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-12-findlay-ohio-5-12-01d2285/ findlay-ohio-5-12-01], DeckTech (brad "swccguy" eier, 12 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-12-findlay-ohio-5-12-01d2285/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Findlay, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Brad Eier]]
